# Studio navigation

Version: 1.0.0
Original getLancer curated recipe. Licence: MIT.

## Setup
Open index.html in a modern browser. No packages, installation, API keys or external assets are required. Optional local server: python3 -m http.server 8000.

## Try
Open Menu, select a section and inspect its active state.

## Files
index.html contains the working HTML, CSS and JavaScript. LICENSE contains redistribution terms. README.md contains this setup guide.

## Accessibility
Keyboard controls, visible focus, 44px targets and reduced-motion support. Test your own modifications before release.

## Dependencies
None. HTML/CSS and browser JavaScript only. No external fonts or images.

## Data and limits
Synthetic data held in preview memory. No account service, production credentials, tracking or network requests.
